title: Total RNA and DNA Extraction from Microalgae Samples
author: Yingyu Hu
materials: Directly add 2.5 mL 1 M pH 8.0 Tris into 500 mL RNase free water in its original package. UltraPure™ DNase/RNase-Free Distilled Water Thermofisher Catalog #10977023 BT Barrier Pipet Tips (Pre-Sterile, Neptune®, BT1250, BT100, BT10)

In the original package, the frozen E. Coli Total RNA is of 1 mg/mL, in which total RNA is 200 ug. E. coli Total RNA Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM7940 https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/sp_7940.pdf

Aliquot 30 uL by stepper with sterile tip to 600 uL RNase free microtubes. Store at -80 °C Finnpipette Stepper Pipette (Thermo Scientific™, 4540000) Finntip stepper pipette tips (500 ul (sterile), Thermo Scientific, Thermo Scientific™ 9404173)

Uncap the original package of Deoxyribonucleic acid from calf thymus and add 2 mL Tris buffer ( 5 mM , pH 8.0 ). Deoxyribonucleic acid from calf thymus Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #D4522-1MG https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/content/dam/sigma-aldrich/docs/Sigma/Product_Information_Sheet/d4522pis.pdf
Cap the package. Do not vortex or sonicate.
Aliquot 10 uL by stepper with sterile tip to 600 uL RNase free microtubes. Store at -20 °C Finntip stepper pipette tips (500 ul (sterile), Thermo Scientific, Thermo Scientific™ 9404173)

Uncap the original package of Ribonuclease A from bovin pancreas and add 5 mL Tris buffer ( 5 mM , pH 8.0 ). Cap the package and invert for a thorough mix. Ribonuclease A from bovine pancreas Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #R6513-50MG

Aliquot 30 uL by stepper with sterile tip to 600 uL RNase free microtubes. Store at -20 °C Finntip stepper pipette tips (500 ul (sterile), Thermo Scientific, Thermo Scientific™ 9404173) Finntip™ Stepper Pipette Tips (500 ul (Sterile), Thermo Scientific, 21-377-149)

Label tubes for reagents as following. Follow the sheet, add Tris buffer ( 5 mM , pH 8.0 ) to the reagent tubes: Content 5 mM Tris (uL) 1 SG-II WS 1000+250 2 WS-B 2X1000+820 3 WS-C 2X1000+940 4 RNase 380 5 900 mM MgCl2 40 6 900 mM CaCl2 40 7 RNA tertiary 690X2 8 DNA tertiary 960 9 0.05% STEB 9X1000 + 500
Thaw Sybr green II at room temperature SYBR™ Green II RNA Gel Stain, 10,000X concentrate in DMSO Thermo Fisher Catalog #S7564
Read fluorescence and export data to excel sheet.

Use reverse pipetting: Load 4 ul DNA and RNA secondary onto the μdrop plate, in duplicate. µDrop™ Plates (Thermo Scientific, N12391) Varioskan LUX Multimode Microplate Reader (Thermo Fisher, VL0L00D0)
Blank is not required in this measurement.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Preservation
steps.instruction: Filter microalgae in liquid media onto polycarbonate filters using gentle vacuum pressure (130 mmHg). Rinse the filter tunnel with filtered artificial seawater (nutrient free) to prevent sample loss.

substeps.instruction: Fold the filter using two tweezers: first in half along the diameter (semicircle), then again in the same direction (long strip), and once more to halve the length.
Place the folded filter in a 2 mL cryogenic vial.
Flash-freeze tubes with liquid nitrogen and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Sample Freeze-Drying
steps.instruction: Freeze-dry samples using a FreeZone® 2.5 L Benchtop Freeze Dryer (Labconco®, 700202000) for the shortest duration possible to reduce degradation. Store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Basic Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the following buffers and solutions in an RNase-free environment:

substeps.instruction: Prepare 5 mM Tris buffer (pH 8.0) using Tris(hydroxymethyl)aminomethane hydrochloride 1M pH 8.0 RNase free (Fisher Scientific #AAJ60080AK).
Prepare 0.5 M EDTA buffer (DNase/RNase free, Bioshop #EDT333.100).
Prepare 20% sarcosine (N-Lauroylsarosine sodium salt solution, Merck MilliporeSigma #L744-50mL).

steps.title: Prepare STEB (1%) Buffer
steps.instruction: Calculate the total volume of 1% STEB required: [# samples x 500 µL] + 500 µL. Mix the following ingredients to obtain 1% STEB:

substeps.instruction: Combine 500 µL sarcosine (20%), 10 µL EDTA (0.5 M), and 9 mL + 490 µL Tris buffer (5 mM, pH 8.0).

steps.title: Prepare DNase Working Solution (WS-A)
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNase primary stock solution (5 mg/ml = 10,000 U/mL) and aliquot it.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL Tris buffer (5 mM, pH 8.0) to the original package of Deoxyribonuclease1 (Bioshop #DRB002.10), cap, and invert to mix.
Use reverse pipetting to aliquot 60 µL into a 5 mL RNase-free tube. Store at -20 °C (this is WS-A).
Note: One package of DNase serves 16 assays.

steps.title: Sample Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Perform sample disruption using a bead mill (Fastprep-24 5G™).

substeps.instruction: Turn on UV light in the biosafety cabinet for 15 minutes and clean the surface with decontamination solution.
Remove freeze-dried samples from -80 °C and place on ice.
Add 500 µL Tris buffer (5 mM, pH 8.0) and 500 µL STEB (1%) to a 2 mL bead tube (Lysing tube matrix D, MP biomedical #116913500).
Use clean forceps (rinsed with 70% ethanol) to transfer the filter into the bead tube, unfolding it into a strip shape as needed.
Invert the tube and place back on ice.
Disrupt samples on the bead mill at 6.5 m/s. Repeat disruption steps, keeping tubes on ice between runs and checking labels.
Continuously shake the homogenate in a multi-head vortex at the highest speed for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Extract Recovery and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Recover the supernatant and prepare aliquots for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge extracted samples at 10,000 x g for 4 minutes at 4 °C.
Invert and mix thoroughly, then use reverse pipetting to aspire 100 µL of supernatant into a 2 mL microtube.
Return any remaining extract in the tip back to the extraction tube.
Transfer all remaining extract to corresponding microtubes in the biosafety cabinet, avoiding debris.
Store sample boxes at -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Assay Working Solutions (WS-A, B, C)
steps.instruction: Prepare the enzyme-containing working solutions on ice.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 900 mM MgCl2: Transfer 360 µL of 1 M MgCl2 (Merck #63069-100ML) into a 5 mL RNase-free tube. Add 60 µL of this to WS-A and 60 µL to WS-B.
Prepare 900 mM CaCl2: Transfer 360 µL of 1 M CaCl2 (Merck #21115-100ML) into a 5 mL RNase-free tube. Add 60 µL of this to WS-A and 60 µL to WS-B.
Prepare RNase working solution (0.5 mg/ml): Add 20 µL RNase primary stock (10 mg/ml) to an RNase tube. Transfer 60 µL of this to WS-B and 60 µL to WS-C.
Label the DNase tube as WS-A and add 2X1000+820 mL 5 mM Tris buffer (Note: text contains a likely typo in volume, preserved as written).

steps.title: Prepare Standards
steps.instruction: Prepare RNA and DNA standard curves.

substeps.instruction: DNA Primary: Add 190 µL 5 mM Tris buffer to DNA primary tube. Measure concentration (target ~500 µg/mL).
RNA Primary: Add 210 µL Tris buffer to RNA primary tube. Measure concentration (target ~200 µg/mL).
DNA Secondary (25 µg/ml): Prepare and mix by aspiring up and down (do not vortex).
RNA Secondary (25 µg/ml): Prepare and mix by aspiring up and down (do not vortex).
DNA Tertiary (1 µg/ml): Transfer 40 µL DNA secondary solution to the tertiary tube. Keep on ice.
RNA Tertiary (2 µg/ml): Transfer 120 µL RNA secondary solution to the tertiary tube. Keep on ice.

steps.title: Sample Dilution and Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Dilute samples and treat with enzymes in three sets (A, B, and C).

substeps.instruction: Set 1: Add 900 µL 5 mM Tris buffer to 100 µL sample extract. Mix thoroughly.
Set A (DNase): Load 50 µL WS-A and the diluted sample/standards into 2 mL tubes. Add 250 µL STEB (0.05%).
Set B (RNase): Load 50 µL WS-B and the diluted sample/standards into 2 mL tubes. Add 250 µL STEB (0.05%).
Set C (DNase + RNase): Load 50 µL WS-A and 50 µL WS-C and the diluted sample/standards into 2 mL tubes. Add 250 µL STEB (0.05%).
Incubate all tubes in a shaking incubator at 37 °C, 200 RPM for 20 minutes.
Invert for mixing, then place in freezer for 2 minutes to stop the reaction.

steps.title: Fluorescence Detection
steps.instruction: Measure RNA and DNA using SYBR Green II (SG-II).

substeps.instruction: Prepare SG-II WS: Centrifuge SG-II concentrate (13,000 rpm, 5 min). Transfer supernatant to a foil-wrapped tube (8.75 µL per 1.25 mL Tris).
Equilibrate samples to room temperature (22 °C) for ~2 minutes.
Load 10 µL SG-II WS into a 96-well black microplate. Cover with black vinyl film.
Reverse pipette 190 µL of working samples into the wells.
Shake the plate at room temperature for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Read fluorescence using a Varioskan LUX: Excitation 490 nm, Emission 520 nm, Bandwidth 12 nm, Continuous shake 5s at 600 rpm.
